system.description:
Each shot uses an Alien Power Cell; up to six can be loaded. It can't draw on the ship's power plant. A hit collapses the target's shields and the Damage goes straight to the Hull. A vehicle that survives is disabled (all systems fail for weeks). A ship takes the Damage on each Fixed and Internal component, and on a critical hit on its weapons and utility mounts too.

Alien artefact: making it usable by a human takes a Repair check (12, or 8 with 2,000cr and a week). Powered by an Alien Power Cell.

Exploration Supplement
system.special: Collapses shields; damages every Fixed and Internal component.
